hypotheses.M0_native_recomposition_is_exact: Native context coefficients recompute to relative error at most 1e-6.
hypotheses.M1_direct_embedding_mean_replacement_is_: Replacing the selected-position direct Layer-17 embedding term by its discovery mean and recomputing attention retains at least 0.98 operator fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.M2_direct_embedding_cycle_is_small: Cyclically substituting the selected-position direct embedding term and recomputing attention retains at least 0.95 fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.M3_embedding_attention_mediation_is_smal: Recomputing rather than holding attention changes embedding-replacement fidelity by at most 0.02 on every corpus.
hypotheses.M4_carried_mean_replacement_is_material: Replacing selected-position carried state by its discovery mean and recomputing attention retains at most 0.80 fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.M5_carried_cycle_is_material: Cyclically substituting selected-position carried state and recomputing attention retains at most 0.90 fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.M6_carried_cost_dominates_embedding_cost: The operator-fidelity cost of carried mean replacement is at least ten times the direct-embedding mean-replacement cost on every corpus.
hypotheses.M7_attention_recomputation_preserves_sou: Carried replacement is more damaging than direct-embedding replacement under both held-attention and recomputed-attention executions on every corpus.
